label: Horizontal Ticker
purpose: Scrolling content ticker that moves horizontally with text, images, or videos
_notes: Horizontal ticker scrolls content horizontally. Its block count, order, and icons are fixed to the base theme's own seed (see 'blocks (fixed — ...)' below) — do not add, remove, or reorder blocks, and do not write an 'icon' setting. Write fresh, short, product-specific text for each block's title/text — EACH block MUST have UNIQUE, DIFFERENT content relevant to the actual product given, never the generic placeholder text seeded in the theme (e.g. never leave pet-supplement copy like 'Digestive Health' on a store selling something else). Think trust badges / marquee claims: 'Free Shipping', 'Money-Back Guarantee', 'Trusted by 10,000+ customers', 'Secure Checkout', '24/7 Support', 'Made with Premium Materials'.
